description: Detect MCP rug pulls: compare a server manifest with the baseline recorded when the server was first checked. Flags changed tool descriptions or schemas, and added or removed tools; escalates to critical when a changed tool now looks malicious or gains command execution. The first check records the baseline.

accept_changes.description: After human review, accept the changes and update the baseline

manifest.description: JSON content of the server manifest (server.json or tools/list result)

server_id.description: Stable identifier for the server, e.g. its registry name or install path

name: mund_check_mcp_rugpull
